name: serve_layer1_plunge
description: Ball 0 starts below the drain line (y=400): the frame-0 drain check (EP2 cs:0A41) empties the last slot and serves at (284,338) with ball_layer[0]=1 (cs:0AFB, not in engine.json serve). EP2 plunger lane has no layer test (cs:0BB4..0BC9, EP1 has cs:0AA4), so the plunge at frames 12..69 launches a layer-1 ball.
